system.description:
Choose two characters (ideally PCs) as Suitors. They court you, even if you're already in a relationship. At the start of play, choose one to be your Love. ________________________________ ________________________________

Take +1 ongoing with your Love when you act to strengthen your relationship.

When you share a moment of intimacy or your feelings with a Suitor who is not currently your Love, they become your new Love. If you initiated this moment, clear a condition. If they initiated it, they clear a condition.

When you insult, break up with, or are disappointed by one of your Suitors, you may cut ties with them. Choose another character to replace them.
